name: Create and retain a My Travel Note
covers: Trip Wrapped generated from saved trips, bookings and notes
description: Verifies a signed-in user's travel note is saved through the protected backend and remains visible after reload.
steps: Sign in to Golden Perfect
Open My Travel Notes
Create a place named Patna if it does not exist
Enter a note titled Weekend at Patna and save it
Reload the app and reopen My Travel Notes
Open Trip Wrapped and verify its summary uses saved trips, bookings and travel notes
Open the middle + menu and select 3D Journey
Search Delhi and set Agra as destination
Tap a map location and inspect nearby places
Build the road route and verify it is drawn on the globe
expected: The note remains visible after reload, Trip Wrapped shows recorded cumulative distance plus state-wise distance and milestone insights, and 3D Journey still opens with its Earth and route controls with India highlighted by the premium boundary.

name: Add more than 21 places without a count cap
description: Verifies the My Travel Notes place collection can continue beyond the previously observed 21-place stopping point.
steps: Sign in to Golden Perfect
Open My Travel Notes
Add places until the account has at least 22 places
Reload My Travel Notes
expected: The 22nd place is created and remains visible after reload.

name: Keep legacy browser data during one-time migration
description: Verifies existing account data is preserved while migration does not copy one account's local cache into another account.
setup: Use an account that already has saved cloud travel notes and places
steps: Sign in to Golden Perfect
Open My Travel Notes
Reload the app
Sign out and sign in with a different email
expected: The second email sees only its own cloud places and notes; the first account's place records are not copied into the second account.

name: Upload a place image and show it immediately
description: Verifies a new travel place with an image persists the file in storage and renders it on the place card.
steps: Sign in to Golden Perfect
Open My Travel Notes
Tap Add Place
Enter Jaipur and choose a local image
Create the place
expected: Jaipur appears in the signed-in account and its uploaded image is visible on the place card.

name: Reject note changes when not authenticated
description: Verifies notes cannot be written to the shared backend without a signed-in identity.
steps: Sign out of Golden Perfect
Open My Travel Notes
Try to add a place or save a note
expected: The app asks the user to sign in and no shared note or place is created.

name: Refresh Trip Wrapped analytics from recorded bookings
description: Verifies Trip Wrapped turns recorded booking distances into a cumulative travel summary with state-level breakdown and usable refresh/share controls.
steps: Sign in to Golden Perfect
Open a saved booking that has a road distance and destination state
Open Trips and select Trip Wrapped
Tap Refresh Trip Wrapped
Inspect the Distance Covered So Far, State Breakdown and Travel Insights sections
Tap Share or Download Wrapped
expected: Trip Wrapped displays the sum of recorded booking distances, groups distance by destination state, shows longest/average/top-state insights, and the refresh/download/share controls are usable.

name: Submit a partnership request from the public home screen
description: Verifies a non-admin visitor can submit a partnership request through the app UI for later admin review.
steps: Open the Golden Perfect home screen
Tap Partner with Golden Perfect
Enter a brand name and valid contact email
Submit the partnership request
Sign in as the authorized admin and open Ad Requests
expected: The user sees a submission confirmation and the saved request appears at the top of the admin Partnership Requests list under Pending, with brand, contact email, submission date, and working approve/reject actions.

name: Admin publishes an information-only job notification
covers: job view and apply click counters
description: Verifies admins can publish official job links and users can browse and apply externally.
steps: Sign in as abgupta802215@gmail.com
Open Admin > Jobs and add a job with HTTPS apply link and a future last date
Publish the job and mark it featured
Open Jobs from the home Latest Jobs strip
Search and open the job detail page
Share the job and tap Apply Now
expected: The published job appears in the public list and Latest Jobs, its detail includes closing information and disclaimer, Share uses a deep link, Apply Now opens the external HTTPS URL, and draft/expired jobs are not public.
